## 🔍 SIGNAL VS NOISE - OPERATIONAL VS ARCHIVE BREAKDOWN

### **Philosophy:**
Health metrics measure **operational readiness** (Can new Claude bootstrap successfully?), not historical completeness.

### **File Count Distribution:**

**Operational Files (Signal - Counted in Health Metrics): 281 files**
```
Markdown files         236 files (docs, profiles, auditors, bootstrap, mission)
Python files           13 files (app.py, pages/, utils/)
JavaScript/TS files    8 files (dashboard/SMV/)
JSON/Config files      13 files (package.json, configs)
CSS/HTML files         ~11 files (dashboard assets)
───────────────────────────────
OPERATIONAL TOTAL:     281 files (verified 2025-11-12 post-relay cleanup)
```

**Archive Files (Noise - Excluded from Health Metrics): 8 files**
```
.Archive/relay/v4_validation_2025-11-12/  25 files (v4.0 validation work)
.Archive/workshop/                        (B-STORM sessions, older archives)
───────────────────────────────────────────
ARCHIVE TOTAL:         8 files (verified 2025-11-12)
```

**Note:** Archive count decreased significantly after relay cleanup moved 25 completed validation files to archives.

### **Total Repository: 289 files (281 operational + 8 archived)**

### **Why This Distinction Matters:**

**Operational files (281):**
- Must maintain 100% link integrity (0 broken links target)
- Counted in health scoring (current: 96/100)
- Subject to version consistency checks
- Must follow current header standards
- Updated when processes change

**Archive files (8):**
- Broken links tolerated (files moved after archival)
- Excluded from health scoring (0% weight)
- Version references frozen at time of archival
- Headers preserved as historical artifacts
- NOT updated retroactively (Gospel Problem prevention)

**Result:** Repository can achieve 96/100 health score even with broken links in archives (by design). Current archive count is low (8 files) as most historical files were already archived in earlier cleanup phases.
